hooks.text: 唯一按键只负责反转环绕方向，越少转向飞船越快、射击也越快
hooks.excerpt: You pilot a ship that orbits the BOSS automatically. PRESS the button to change the ship’s direction 🔄. But the less you change directions, the faster the ship goes. The faster you go, the faster you shoot. The faster you shoot, the faster you WIN!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 把转向替换成冲刺、把子弹换成激光，攻击与移动可拼出百种组合
hooks.excerpt: You can customize the ship, mixing ATTACK and MOVEMENT upgrades to find the best builds to beat bosses. DASH instead of changing directions, fire a LASER instead of bullets. There’s over 100 different combinations you can try out to suit your playstyle!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 无薪助理Ace闯过五十关弹幕，被老板嘲讽也要升职争取公平薪水
hooks.excerpt: ACE THE ASSISTANT will loop you into the 50 handcrafted levels of bullet hell action. The bosses will taunt you as you lose, but if you persist you will rise up the ranks, progress the story, earn GRIND POINTS and unlock new ways to play!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
